page.overview:
Who is Elodie D'vyen?

is a rich merchant and one of the partners of Halandil Fang. As an NPC, she is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Elodie is a beautiful human woman in her early forties. She dresses in expensive clothes made of rich imported fabric.

Elodie was born in a respectable family from outside of Dol-Makjar. At some point in the last two decades, she began a relationship with the bard Halandil Fang; when they started dating, her grandmother warned her that she should have an answer ready for whenever her actor boyfriend inevitably asked her for money. the couple had a daughter together, Hero. The same year the baby was born Elodie was living with Hal and his two children with Thaisha in the Rookery; back then the relationship was so happy that a wedding was being considered, and Elodie was starting a business in fabrics.

As of the year 71, Elodie had become a rich merchant and lived with her daughter (who was also involved in the business), although still being in a relationship with Hal and in contact with his relatives despite no longer planning to marry him, nor living with him.
